title: Open Heart and the Silent Vigil
summary: At 6:00 AM on Monday, February 9, 2015, surrounded by eleven members of his family at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke, Jordan is wheeled into the operating room for open-heart CABG surgery. After Dr. Hassan successfully grafts his Left Internal Mammary Artery around the calcified blockage, the family keeps a silent, disciplined vigil around his ventilator bed in the CVICU.

scenes.title: Do Not Touch Him (The CVICU Vigil)
